localEnvironmentIssue.impact: Reused PGlite returned visits outside the unchanged monthly date predicate. Direct SQL reproduced 125 rows versus the exact 100 from a sequential scan. No claim about the underlying engine defect or native PostgreSQL behavior.
localEnvironmentIssue.resolution: Final volume suite recreated the current schema in a new isolated database, with default query planning, and passed all original assertions. No production query/filter was weakened and no indexes or planner options were changed in the application. Diagnostic insertions were rolled back.

limitations: Single synthetic workload per scale, no latency percentile or production SLA. RSS is for the Node API and local HTTP client together; database server and browser memory are excluded.
64 MiB response, 768 MiB sampled RSS and 30 seconds are QA regression guards only; runtime APIs retain their existing transaction timeouts.
Metrics query the current UTC day, so historical fixture visits and invoices must not enter its daily aggregates. Peak current-day traffic is not certified.
Full eligible alert/risk collections and external-billing history still scale in memory; no production volume, simultaneous-request or VPS certification.
